items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for MNF vs Dallas.
items.implication: More targets to remaining Eagles pass-catchers; Saquon still Q/expected.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts again. Third straight miss.
items.why: High ankle sprain; returned to limited practice but ruled out.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded; Huntley start limits upside for pass-catchers.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) QUESTIONABLE/GTD; took majority of Thursday practice but no power/explosion, will test pregame. Minor per reports.
items.why: Calf issue felt during practice; McVay details.
items.implication: If out, TE-heavy hierarchy (Higbee lead) with Adams already OUT.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE target share historically ~37% without Puka.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play MNF vs Cowboys; DeVonta OUT.
items.why: Returned to practice (limited then full indicators); hamstring.
items.implication: Start if active vs soft DAL run D; Berry loves if active.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected in good matchup.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.why: Activated; facility access noted earlier by Levitan.
items.implication: Workload questions post-layoff; Berry hates/fades. Backups poor (Lloyd/Johnson).

items.text: If Puka out: Stafford targets Higbee 1, Mumpfield 2, Parkinson 3, Atwell 4, Whittington 5, Allen 6. Adams already OUT.
items.why: McVay calf details; historical TE share 37% without Puka.
items.implication: TE streaming/upside if inactive; Berry notes same.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); 49ers D inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most), recent RB receptions high. Sweet spot for Bijan full workload.
items.why: BRob listed out; DvP data + recent RB production vs SF.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT, Kirk Q). CMC slot temptation amid WRs.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel to TE/CMC; National TE Day irrelevant.
items.implication: Kittle elite play; CMC possible slot boost (rare but tempted by dire WRs + Black).
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; CMC routes/snaps expansion.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK/LOVE: 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games since Caleb return.
LOVE Jaylen Warren: more I watch, love his game; Steelers special; big workload friendly matchup.
TreVeyon Henderson just 21% snaps last 3 weeks; downgrade.
Luther Burden 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-sets for more juice.
HATE Josh Jacobs @DET: workload questions after long layoff.
LOVE A.J. Brown: 97% routes, 33% TS in Wk6 despite drops/yards; buying the volume.
